_note: Answer-correctness keys, kept OUT of golden_set.jsonl so that file stays byte-identical and its sha256 (recorded in the baseline run) remains valid. An answer counts correct only if it contains one of the required strings, matched case-insensitively and whitespace-tolerantly, so '6 g' also matches '6g'. A refusal is never counted correct - it is recorded as refused and then labelled R or Not-In-Corpus.
